tei:bibl.tei:title: Prayerbook for the New Year [First Day]
tei:bibl.tei:note: Digital imaging and document preparation: Aharon N. Varady; copy held by the HUC-JIR Klau Library, Cincinnati. The scan is the source. Independent reader: Claude Opus 5.5; CLI configured for medium reasoning. No translations have been supplied for passages absent from the English edition.

The shared morning sequence reaches Yishtabbach, with explicit canonical repetition ofExodus15:18 and no supplied English15:19. HalfKaddish and later material are next. Original standing instruction through afterBarkhu is retained. Psalm24remains the preexisting named appendix fromscan351, not a morning continuation.

The scan prints directions without Kaddish words: reuse compatible Birnbaum Hebrew Half, Whole and Mourner’s Kaddish. The combined Shabbat/festival light blessing is also absent from this volume; its already printed Birnbaum option supplies that calendar variant. Retain credits/licence and provide no English fallback. The newly printed maḥzor Half Kaddish is a fixed Ten Days witness. Preparatory Elul29 Kaddish remains bound to compatible Birnbaum Hebrew, without importing its absent English; self-bind Birnbaum Kaddish components to preserve that choice. This installment additionally prints a direction for Hamotzi without its words; compatible Birnbaum Hebrew supplies that named dependency. No English fallback is added. The newly transcribed maḥzor Yigdal now supplies that canonical poem, including its printed English translation, in both morning and evening occurrences.
